skill.name: dittobot
skill.description: Rewrite, edit, tighten, punch up, or diagnose user-provided prose while preserving the user's voice, intent, facts, stance, rhythm, humor, and formality. Use it for emails, posts, essays, internal docs, website copy, speeches, bios, captions, cover letters, and similar drafts.
skill.summary: Voice-preserving prose editor for rewriting drafts while protecting facts, stance, and constraints.
skill.author: RegionallyFamous

security_audit.summary: The strongest confirmed issue is the documented curl-to-bash installer path, which executes remote mutable content without checksum verification. The install tooling also modifies the hidden user skills directory, and optional live evaluation can send prompts and an API key to an external endpoint. Most other static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, GPL text, regression fixtures, or defensive redaction code.

remediation.issue: README documents curl piped directly to bash.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the pipe-to-shell command with a download, checksum verification, and explicit local execution step.

remediation.issue: install.sh downloads a mutable branch or environment-selected archive before running installer code.
remediation.suggestion: Pin installs to immutable release tags and published checksums. Require explicit confirmation for any custom archive URL or repository override.

remediation.issue: install.py can replace or move an existing skill under ~/.agents/skills/dittobot.
remediation.suggestion: Add a confirmation prompt or dry-run mode before moving existing installs, creating symlinks, or replacing user skill files.

remediation.issue: live_eval.py handles OPENAI_API_KEY and can save evaluation transcripts.
remediation.suggestion: Keep live evaluation outside the default install path, document the opt-in behavior clearly, and keep raw transcript saving disabled by default.

remediation.issue: The JPEG banner is binary content that static analysis cannot inspect.
remediation.suggestion: Publish a source hash or generated-source note for binary assets so reviewers can verify provenance.

content.user_title: Rewrite Prose In Your Own Voice
content.value_statement: Generic AI edits often flatten voice and add unsupported polish. Dittobot rewrites user-provided text while preserving facts, stance, rhythm, and constraints.
actual_capabilities: Rewrites emails, posts, essays, internal notes, captions, bios, speeches, and cover letters from supplied text.
Preserves facts, claims, dates, names, uncertainty, emotional stance, and explicit user constraints.
Supports proofreading, light edits, tightening, rewrites, structural edits, tone options, diagnosis, and comparisons.
Builds compact voice profiles from writing samples when the user asks for reusable guidance.
Includes local regression, scorecard, redaction, and fixture tools for maintainers who validate rewrite behavior.
limitations: It works best with source text, notes, or writing samples. It is not meant for unsupported ghostwriting.
It does not verify factual, legal, medical, financial, or academic claims independently.
It may ask a clarifying question when purpose, audience, or safety constraints are unclear.
Repository scripts are maintainer tools. Normal prose editing should not require running them.

use_cases.title: Polish Work Messages
use_cases.description: Turn rough emails, updates, and announcements into clear messages that keep the original facts and stance.

use_cases.title: Protect A Personal Voice
use_cases.description: Improve posts, bios, captions, and essays without sanding away humor, rhythm, or useful rough edges.

use_cases.title: Validate Rewrite Quality
use_cases.description: Use the included local tools to test fact preservation, voice fidelity, constraints, and public-safe fixtures.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Up A Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $dittobot on this. Keep my facts and voice, but make it clearer and shorter: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Create Tone Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare possible tones before choosing one
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $dittobot on this. Give me three versions: warmer, sharper, and concise. Preserve the claims: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Without Rewriting
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $dittobot to diagnose this draft. Do not rewrite it. Give the three highest-impact notes: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Build A Voice Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $dittobot to infer a reusable voice profile from these samples. Include use, avoid, rhythm, protected quirks, and when not to apply: [paste samples]

output_examples.input: A launch note is too long and unclear, but it must mention the importer fix and retry support.
output_examples.output: A concise launch note that keeps the importer fix, retry support, and calm tone without adding new claims.

output_examples.input: A post sounds generic and inflated, but the source does not include supporting details.
output_examples.output: A plainer version that removes empty claims and adds a short note asking for real specifics.

output_examples.input: A personal paragraph has an odd image that carries the writer's voice.
output_examples.output: A cleaner paragraph that keeps the image intact and only fixes the framing around it.

best_practices: Paste the source text and state the audience, purpose, and any hard constraints.
Mark facts, names, dates, claims, and phrases that must survive the edit.
Ask for options when tone is subjective or the message has social risk.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a new draft without source material when voice preservation matters.
Do not treat a voice profile as permission to import old facts into a new piece.
Do not run maintainer scripts for ordinary editing tasks.

faq.question: What does Dittobot do?
faq.answer: It rewrites and edits supplied prose while preserving the writer's facts, voice, stance, and constraints.

faq.question: Does it write from scratch?
faq.answer: It can help with drafts in an established voice, but it is designed for text the user provides.

faq.question: Can it handle sensitive or high-stakes writing?
faq.answer: It preserves uncertainty and precision, but it does not replace legal, medical, financial, or factual review.

faq.question: Does normal use require network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructions are local, but optional live evaluation scripts can call the OpenAI API.

faq.question: What are voice profiles?
